keyword: where to watch ncaa final four
claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is on Saturday, April 4, in Indianapolis.
TBS and truTV will air the semifinal games of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four.
The 2026 Men's Final Four Game 1 (UConn vs. Illinois) is at ~6:00 PM ET on April 4.
The 2026 Men's Final Four Game 2 (Michigan vs. Arizona) is at ~8:54 PM ET on April 4.
The Women's Final Four games are broadcast on the ESPN family of networks.
